title: Finite triangular approximation of radial sweeps
main_claim: Theorem 1.1: if a radial segment sweep satisfies the alignment condition w'(t)=λ(t)(a+tb), then for any tagged partition it has a cover by N cylinders, one per interval, each with a frozen axis e+w(c_i) and a triangular base. The total base area tends to κ∫R²/(2√(1+|w|²)) as the mesh goes to zero, and the same holds when the bases are the actual projected sweeps. Corollary 1.2: every regular tetrahedron has a finite cylinder cover with triangular bases whose total cost is below A_min/2, and whose directionwise-normalized cost is below 1/2.
coverage:
I checked Section 2 (proof of Thm 1.1) line by line. The intercept coordinates u and v-tu are derived correctly from w'=λ(a+tb). The footprint bounds hold with A=LM and B=LM/2. Triangle containment with C=2(A+B)+1 holds for both u≥0 and -Ad≤u<0. The exact triangle area formula and the 1/‖v_I‖ projection factor are right. The collar contributes O(d²) per interval, so the Riemann sum converges, and the lower bound for the actual bases holds via the sector E_I.

I checked Section 3 (Cor 1.2) in full. The model tetrahedron has its claimed vertices, edge length 4, A_min=4√2 and two-cylinder cost 2h. The upper sweep matches the theorem's data (λ=-ε, κ=h, L=2), and the rotated sweep gives the lower one. The root equations and the crossing lemma give ρ,σ≥0. In the failure inequality, |t|≤2ε, |x-p|,|y-q|≤3ε, the exact identity for (xq-yp)/ε, and the error total of 9ε against the 10ε cubic cap padding all check out.

The cost expansion is correct: ∫H=8/15 and ∫D0/4=17/30, so I(ε)=1-ε²/30+10ε³+O(ε⁴). I confirmed this numerically with scipy quad at ε=0.001, 0.003 and 0.01. I also ran a Monte Carlo coverage test at ε=0.05 using first-crossing roots; it found no uncovered points. The final finite-partition choice and the normalized-cost corollary are valid. Appendix A's simplex projection identity looked correct on a skim. I only skimmed the alternative beam construction (Section 4) and Appendices B–D, which the main results do not depend on.
